h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Srikakulam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Srikakulam

items.pText: Srikakulam lies on the north Andhra coast, where cyclones from the Bay of Bengal arrive every few years with strong winds and heavy rain. A playground here has to stay firmly in the ground through a storm. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Srikakulam at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,160 km away.

The town sits on the Nagavali river, close to the Odisha border, with a hot, humid climate for most of the year. Coastal sites here are usually reached easily by road, and our team or a dealer in south India installs the equipment. Send us your site size, photos and the ages of the children who will play there. Our layout drawing then marks each piece and its safe play area.

richText.heading: Preparing play equipment for cyclone season

c: Grouted footings in concrete hold posts much more firmly than shallow fixings, so we recommend grouting on open coastal ground. Keep the play area away from tall trees and old walls that could fall in strong wind.

When a cyclone warning is issued, tie up or remove swing seats so they do not swing into the frame, and clear loose items from around the site. Once the storm has passed, check every piece before children return. Look for bent pipes, loose bolts, washed-out soil at the footings and debris on slides. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle salt air and rain well. See nearby

items.q: Will playground equipment withstand a cyclone?
items.a: Grouted footings and galvanised steel give it a much better chance. Remove swing seats when a warning is issued and inspect every piece after the storm before children play again.

items.q: What should we check after a storm?
items.a: Bent or damaged pipes, loose bolts, cracked plastic, washed-out soil around footings and debris on slides. Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything is damaged.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Srikakulam district?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road to the town and the district, and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.
